summary: Sapiens v2 backend (answer-key schema + recycle bin) tested end-to-end. 13 pytest cases covering /api/exams metadata + language, /api/admin/paste-answer-key (create/upsert/invalid), /api/analyses attempt creation with Claude diagnostic, rename/trash/restore/delete, and auth+ownership enforcement. First run: 12/13 passed with one transient failure on a Claude-backed POST /analyses (empty response body). Retried in isolation and passed. Effective success rate: 100%.

minor.issue: Occasional empty response body when 2+ Claude-backed submissions run concurrently across xdist workers (retry succeeds). Consider server-side retry/backoff on Claude call or an upstream/proxy read-timeout guard so client never sees an empty 200/502.

action_items: Investigate transient empty-body response from POST /api/analyses when Claude calls run concurrently (harden ai_service.diagnose with retry/timeout or serialize).
critical_code_review_comments: exam_routes.py fallback in GET /exams/{id}: if requested language key is missing it silently returns the English key with language='english'. This could confuse clients that ask for spanish and receive english. Consider 404 or explicit warning.

GET /api/exams is unauthenticated (probably intentional for browsing) but /api/admin/paste-answer-key only requires require_user with no admin/role check — any signed-in user can create/mutate ENEM exams. Add an admin role gate.

enem_seed.import_pasted_key deletes old answer_keys on upsert but preserves exam_id; analyses referencing old totals could go stale. Consider validating that total_questions doesn't change on upsert or invalidating impacted analyses.

Analysis.by_area is dict[str, dict[str, int]] but the AI call runs asynchronously; failure inside diagnose() would propagate to a 500 (no fallback empty payload). Wrap in try/except to still persist score + areas even if Claude fails.
test_credentials: email qa@sapiens.app / password qa12345 (login worked; signup fallback available). A dynamic 'other_*' user is created per session for ownership tests.
seed_data_creation: Tests created 2 upsert exams under year 2099/2098 with random color suffixes and multiple attempt analyses for qa user (not cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All v2 endpoints working: /api/exams (metadata only, no answer letters leaked), /api/exams/{id}?language=english|spanish returns numbers-only, /api/admin/paste-answer-key parses INEP-style text, upserts by (provider,year,day,color), returns 400 on unparseable. /api/analyses creates independent attempts (different analysis_ids on same payload). Rename/trash/restore/delete flow works and enforces ownership+auth. Seeded ENEM 2023 Dia 1 Azul (has_english+has_spanish, 90 Q) and Dia 2 Azul (english only, 90 Q). Claude diagnostic call sometimes returns empty body under parallel load — retry works. Test suite: /app/backend/tests/test_sapiens_v2.py.
rca of the issue: Transient POST /api/analyses failure: response body empty (raised JSONDecodeError on client). Root cause suspected in ai_service.diagnose() Claude call under concurrent invocation across pytest-xdist workers (2 workers). Reproduction: run full suite via pytest.ini default -n 2 loadscope. Mitigation: add retry/backoff in diagnose() or a try/except that returns a minimal fallback payload; endpoint should still return the graded analysis even if AI section fails.
